title_en: Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Strengthening the Supervision of Economic Work

articles.content_en: I. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall exercise its supervisory power over the economic work of the State Council according to law. The Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress and relevant special committees shall, under the leadership of the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee, undertake relevant specific work. The State Council and its relevant departments shall provide assistance and cooperation.

II. In carrying out supervision over economic work, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall uphold the leadership of the Communist Party of China, adhere to the guidance of Marxism-Leninism, Mao Zedong Thought, Deng Xiaoping Theory, the important thought of Three Represents, the Scientific Outlook on Development, and Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, adhere to the people-centered development philosophy, uphold and improve the basic socialist economic system, ensure and promote the market to play a decisive role in resource allocation and better play the role of the government, base on the new stage of development, implement the new development philosophy, build a new development pattern, and promote high-quality development.

III. Pursuant to the relevant provisions of the Rules of Procedure of the National People's Congress, the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress shall, forty-five days before the session of the National People's Congress, together with the relevant special committees, conduct a preliminary examination of the annual plan for national economic and social development, form preliminary examination opinions, and send them to the relevant competent department of the State Council. The relevant competent department of the State Council shall promptly provide feedback on the handling status to the Financial and Economic Committee.
During the preliminary examination conducted by the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress, the relevant special committees may carry out special examinations, put forward special examination opinions, and send them to the Financial and Economic Committee for study and handling.

V. The key points of the preliminary examination of the annual plan for national economic and social development are: the completion status of the previous year's plan for national economic and social development, especially the completion of the main targets and tasks; the guiding ideology for the formulation of the current year's plan for national economic and social development shall conform to the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference, and comply with the outline of the five-year plan for national economic and social development and the medium- and long-term plan outline; the main targets, key tasks, and major engineering projects shall conform to the conditions of economic and social development, especially the actual supporting capacity of resources, financial resources, and the environment, meet the basic requirements for implementing the five-year plan outline, and be conducive to long-term healthy economic and social development; the main policy direction and measures arrangements shall conform to the requirements of improving institutional mechanisms and law-based administration, adhere to goal orientation and problem orientation, be targeted and feasible, and fiscal and monetary policies shall match the main targets.

VII. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall strengthen the supervision over the implementation of the annual plan for national economic and social development approved by the National People's Congress.
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall, in August each year, hear and deliberate the report of the State Council on the implementation of the plan for national economic and social development for the preceding period of the current year. The deliberation opinions of the members of the Standing Committee shall be submitted to the State Council for study and handling, and the State Council shall submit a written report to the Standing Committee on the status of study and handling. The report on the implementation of the annual plan for national economic and social development, the deliberation opinions of the members of the Standing Committee, and the State Council's study and handling of the deliberation opinions shall be notified to the deputies to the National People's Congress and published to the public.
The Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress shall, in conjunction with the analysis of the economic situation in the first half of the year, make relevant preparations and submit an analysis report to the Standing Committee.

VIII. The key points of supervision over the implementation of the annual plan for national economic and social development are: the implementation of the annual plan for national economic and social development shall implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the spirit of the Central Economic Work Conference, implement the requirements of the resolutions of the National People's Congress, and conform to the requirements of various goals and tasks set forth in the government work report; the completion of main targets, especially binding targets, and the progress of key tasks and major engineering projects shall conform to the schedule of the annual plan for national economic and social development; the report on the implementation of the plan for national economic and social development shall conduct in-depth analysis of the main difficulties and problems and their causes, provide explanations and interpretations for indicators and tasks that have not reached the expected progress, and propose targeted and feasible policy measures to promote the smooth completion of the annual plan for national economic and social development.

IX. The Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress shall hold quarterly economic situation analysis meetings in mid-April, July, and October each year, to hear reports from the relevant departments of the State Council on the operation of the national economy in the first quarter, the first half year, and the first three quarters, conduct analysis and research, report the analysis of the operation of the national economy and the opinions and suggestions raised at the meetings to the Council of Chairmen, and send them to the General Office of the State Council and relevant departments, as well as the general offices of the standing committees of the people's congresses of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government in the form of meeting minutes and briefs.

X. The preliminary examination and examination of the draft outline of the five-year plan for national economic and social development and the draft outline of the medium- and long-term plan shall be carried out with reference to the provisions of Articles 3 and 6 of this Decision.
In the year before the draft outline of the five-year plan and the draft outline of the medium- and long-term plan are submitted to the National People's Congress for examination and approval, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall conduct special investigations on the preparation of the five-year plan outline and the medium- and long-term plan outline, hear reports on the investigation work, and send the investigation report to relevant parties for study and reference, so as to make preparations for the examination and approval by the National People's Congress.
The General Office of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and the Financial and Economic Committee shall undertake specific organizational work, formulate investigation work plans, coordinate relevant special committees and working bodies of the Standing Committee to conduct special investigations, and integrate the investigation results.

XII. The key points of the preliminary examination of the draft outline of the five-year plan and the draft outline of the medium- and long-term plan are: the implementation of the previous five-year plan outline; the guiding ideology for the formulation of this five-year plan outline shall conform to the spirit of the Party Central Committee's proposals on the five-year plan, and be able to play the role of a blueprint and action program for the next five years; the main targets, key tasks, and major engineering projects shall conform to China's national conditions and development stage, conform to the objective laws of economic and social development, conform to the national medium- and long-term strategic development goals, and take into account both necessity and feasibility; the main policy direction shall conform to the Party's basic theory, basic line, and basic strategy, be targeted and feasible.

XIII. The State Council shall strengthen the dynamic monitoring, mid-term evaluation, and final evaluation of the implementation of the five-year plan outline. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall strengthen the supervision over the implementation of the five-year plan outline.
The Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress and the relevant special committees shall, under the leadership of the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee, carry out targeted supervision over the implementation of the five-year plan outline and promote the smooth implementation of the five-year plan outline.
The relevant competent department of the State Council shall submit the dynamic monitoring materials on the implementation of the five-year plan outline to the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress.

XIV. During the mid-term stage of the implementation of the five-year plan outline, the State Council shall submit the mid-term evaluation report on the implementation of the five-year plan outline to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for deliberation. The deliberation opinions of the members of the Standing Committee shall be submitted to the State Council for study and handling, and the State Council shall submit a written report to the Standing Committee on the status of study and handling. The mid-term evaluation report on the implementation of the five-year plan outline, the deliberation opinions of the members of the Standing Committee, and the State Council's study and handling of the deliberation opinions shall be notified to the deputies to the National People's Congress and published to the public. The Financial and Economic Committee shall, together with the relevant special committees, conduct special investigations and submit an investigation report to the Standing Committee.
The key points of supervision over the mid-term evaluation of the implementation of the five-year plan outline are: the implementation of the five-year plan outline shall conform to the spirit of the Party Central Committee's proposals, implement the requirements of the resolutions of the National People's Congress; the completion of main targets, especially binding targets, and the progress of key tasks and major engineering projects shall conform to the schedule of the five-year plan outline; the mid-term evaluation report on the implementation of the five-year plan outline shall conduct in-depth analysis of the main difficulties and problems and their causes, provide explanations and interpretations for indicators and tasks that have not reached the expected progress, and propose targeted and feasible policy measures to promote the smooth completion of the five-year plan outline.

XVII. After the annual plan for national economic and social development and the five-year plan outline are approved by the National People's Congress, if partial adjustments are needed during implementation, the State Council shall submit the adjustment plan to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for examination and approval. The submission of the adjustment plan for the annual plan for national economic and social development shall generally not be later than the end of the third quarter of the current year; the submission of the adjustment plan for the five-year plan outline shall generally not be later than the end of the second quarter of the fourth year of its implementation. Except under special circumstances, the State Council shall submit the adjustment plan to the Standing Committee thirty days before the meeting of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.
Except under special circumstances, the relevant competent department of the State Council shall, forty-five days before the meeting of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, submit the State Council's adjustment plan to the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress, which shall conduct a preliminary examination and submit a report on the results of the examination to the Standing Committee.
The adjustment plan for the annual plan for national economic and social development and the five-year plan outline approved by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall be reported to the next session of the National People's Congress.

XVIII. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall strengthen supervision according to law around the central economic work and overall situation of the Party and the state, focusing on the implementation of work in such areas as deepening economic system reform, optimizing the business environment, strengthening scientific and technological innovation, promoting coordinated regional development, adhering to green and low-carbon development, ensuring and improving people's livelihood, promoting common prosperity, advancing high-level opening up, and safeguarding national economic security. Where necessary, it may hear and deliberate special work reports of the State Council, conduct special inquiries, or adopt resolutions.
The Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress, relevant special committees, and relevant working bodies of the Standing Committee shall, under the leadership of the Standing Committee, do a good job in relevant work and urge the relevant departments of the State Council to better advance the implementation of work.

XX. For particularly major national construction projects that are wide-ranging, far-reaching, and involve huge investment, the State Council may submit a bill to the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee, which shall be deliberated and decided by the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee.
Pursuant to the arrangements of the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee, the Financial and Economic Committee shall, together with the relevant special committees, conduct a preliminary examination of the bill mentioned in the preceding paragraph and submit an examination report to the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee.

XXI. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall, as necessary, hear work reports from the State Council and deliberate on major engineering projects determined in the annual plan for national economic and social development and the five-year plan outline, and the particularly major national construction projects mentioned in Article 20 of this Decision. Where it deems necessary, it may adopt resolutions.
Pursuant to the arrangements of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the Financial and Economic Committee may, together with the relevant special committees and relevant working bodies of the Standing Committee, conduct special investigations on the implementation of the projects mentioned in the preceding paragraph and submit special investigation reports to the Standing Committee.
The relevant competent department of the State Council shall, every half year, provide the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress with relevant materials on the implementation of the central budget investment plan.

XXIII. For treaties and agreements on economic matters concluded with foreign countries or international organizations, where, pursuant to the provisions of the Law on the Procedure for the Conclusion of Treaties, they shall be subject to the decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for ratification or accession, the State Council shall submit a bill to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for deliberation and decision. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Rules of Procedure of the Standing Committee, the bill may be referred to the Financial and Economic Committee for deliberation opinions.
The amendment, denunciation, or withdrawal from the treaties and agreements mentioned in the preceding paragraph shall be handled by reference to the procedures for their conclusion.

XXIV. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall strengthen the supervision over the economic work of the State Council and its relevant departments by means of hearing and deliberating special work reports, law enforcement inspections, inquiries and interpellations, investigations of specific issues, special investigations, etc.
Pursuant to the arrangements of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the Financial and Economic Committee and the relevant special committees may hold meetings to hear special reports from the relevant departments of the State Council.
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, the Financial and Economic Committee, and the relevant special committees may use the results of audit supervision, financial and accounting supervision, and statistical supervision, engage research institutions and experts and scholars, entrust third-party evaluations, and use big data technologies to improve the effectiveness of economic work supervision.

XXV. With respect to the resolutions, decisions, and deliberation opinions made by the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee in the supervision over economic work, the Standing Committee shall strengthen follow-up supervision, urge the State Council and its relevant departments to implement the resolutions and decisions, carefully study and handle opinions and suggestions, and provide timely feedback. Where the Standing Committee deems it necessary, it may hear and deliberate the special work report of the State Council on relevant matters. The State Council shall, within the prescribed period, report to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the implementation of the decisions and resolutions or the study and handling of deliberation opinions. The Financial and Economic Committee shall undertake the specific work of follow-up supervision.
Where a decision or resolution is not implemented or is implemented ineffectively, resulting in serious consequences, the National People's Congress or its Standing Committee may strengthen supervision through means such as special inquiries, interpellations, and investigations of specific issues.

XXVI. The situation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress in exercising its powers of supervision over economic work shall be reported to the National People's Congress and subject to supervision. The opinions and suggestions put forward by the Financial and Economic Committee and the relevant special committees shall be reported to the Council of Chairmen, which shall decide whether to forward them to the State Council and its relevant departments for study and handling, and shall report the results to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

XXVII. In carrying out supervision over economic work, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress shall give full play to the role of the deputies to the National People's Congress, earnestly listen to their opinions and suggestions, actively respond to their concerns, and support them in performing their duties according to law.
The Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress and the relevant special committees shall establish and improve the working mechanism for contacting deputies regarding supervision over economic work. When determining supervision projects and carrying out supervision work, they shall earnestly listen to the opinions and suggestions of the deputies to the National People's Congress. The Financial and Economic Committee and the relevant special committees shall, focusing on the prominent issues in economic and social development raised in deputies' proposals and suggestions and of general concern to deputies, organize and carry out special investigations.
When the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress conducts a preliminary examination of the annual plan for national economic and social development and the draft outline of the five-year plan, it shall invite deputies to the National People's Congress to participate. For supervision work on other matters listed in this Decision, deputies to the National People's Congress from relevant fields may be invited to participate as needed.
The relevant situation of carrying out supervision over economic work shall be promptly notified to the deputies to the National People's Congress through the deputies' working body, and relevant materials shall be promptly sent to the deputies to the National People's Congress.

XXVIII. When the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress hears, deliberates, and discusses the matters listed in this Decision, the State Council and its relevant departments shall, as required, promptly provide relevant information, data, and explanations of the situation, and send a responsible person from the State Council or the relevant department to report the situation at the meeting, listen to opinions, and answer inquiries.
When the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress and the relevant special committees hear, deliberate, and discuss the matters listed in this Decision, the relevant departments of the State Council shall, as required, promptly provide relevant information, data, and explanations of the situation, and send the relevant responsible person from the department to report the situation at the meeting, listen to opinions, and answer inquiries.
The relevant departments of the State Council shall, in accordance with the requirements of the Financial and Economic Committee of the National People's Congress and the relevant special committees, use the national e-government network and other means to regularly provide data and relevant materials on national economic and social development.

XXIX. The situation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress in carrying out supervision over economic work shall be made public to the society, except as otherwise provided by law.
This Decision shall come into force on the date of its promulgation.
